outputs.child_base_fare_screen: all three declared ages within published child band; source restrictions still apply
outputs.family_room_screen: party exceeds published two-child capacity; no verified match
outputs.bedroom_suite_screen: five people exceeds published four-person maximum; no verified match

assumptions: identical eligible adult base fare F for all five travelers on one selected service/reservation
no additional discount, fare-bucket, tax/fee, sleeper or package adjustment

decision.outcome: WATCH existing-city rail budget handoff; REJECT generic national scenic-list URL
decision.hypothesis: A child-discount headline and family-room name establish a cheap five-person rail holiday
decision.result: rejected; age-based fare and room capacity are distinct, complete cost and current job materiality unknown
decision.confidence: High inspected policy/category distinctions and conditional algebra; unknown route availability, exact fare, narrow demand, user fit or SEO outcome
decision.remaining_gate: Controlled distinct-job/material-demand/overlap where authorized; one named service's exact-party public fare/class/fees/refund and available sleeping configuration; dated same-party hotel budget and independently supported arrival-to-base task. Existing NYC owner first, no newURL approval
decision.next_eligible_run: One higher-priority city corpus/rest gate first; reopen rail watch only for current demand evidence or a named service-budget/arrival feasibility task, not another generic cluster summary
decision.falsification_trigger: Official age/category terms change, exact-party service quote contradicts screen, or replicated distinct demand plus maintained output exceeds existing-city fit
